decisions.resolution_risk: Subjective creator grading means idiosyncratic test cases or prompt nuances could lead to a negative assessment even if synthetic benchmarks exceed the bar.
evidence_for: The comparison bar is frozen at older frontier models (Opus 4.7 and GPT 5.5) rather than the moving frontier.
Gemini 3.5 Flash and Gemini 3.7 Flash already demonstrate coding benchmark parity or superiority relative to mid-2026 frontier baselines like Opus 4.7.
